conviction_note: Q3 business volume and EBT and the second 2026 guidance raise all came out in the 5 Nov ad-hoc, so the 13 Nov Quartalsmitteilung carries only revenue, net income, cash flow, backlog and call colour. The one unknown line with sign risk is operating cash flow (H1 -EUR101.7m, Q2 -EUR112.5m). This name faded both of its 2026 pre-release-then-report sequences (12 Aug -3.78% after a +3.4% gap; 5 Nov from +8% intraday to +1.95%, then -3.24% the next day), so p_up 45 on a 3.8% abs move gives -0.38. The findings sum to -1.2 because the cash-flow finding, sized on its own, outweighs the small positive guide arithmetic. The two numbers agree in sign.

First 2026 raise (ad-hoc 28 Jul, report 12 Aug): H1 operating cash flow -EUR101.7m (Q2 -EUR112.5m) on an order-backed inventory build; FY operating cash flow expected 'firmly positive'; backlog EUR3.5bn

unknown, the main sign risk. Q3 2025 OCF was +EUR124.9m; with BV +19% and memory-driven inventory, Q3 2026 OCF could again be weak. A clear swing positive would be the upside surprise

findings.finding: Operating cash flow is the one line the release adds that carries sign risk: H1 2026 OCF was -EUR101.7m (Q2 -EUR112.5m against +EUR45.2m a year earlier) on an order-backed inventory build, Q3 BV grew even faster (+19%), and the company has only promised 'firmly positive' OCF for the full year. Q3 2025 OCF was +EUR124.9m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 12 Aug 2026: the half-year report carrying the -EUR112m Q2 OCF opened +3.4% and closed -3.78%, after the 28 Jul ad-hoc had already priced the beat (+14.8%). That cash flow caused the fade is an inference: no source names it.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the 5 Nov ad-hoc nor any article since mentions Q3 cash flow; the coverage after the ad-hoc (Boersen-Zeitung, goldesel, boerse-global) is about EBT and the guide. If a weak Q3 OCF were priced, the ad-hoc's +8% intraday would not have faded on generic tech weakness alone.
findings.independence: Same company document family. The goldesel note says investors should wait for the full report on 'Umsatz und Profitabilitaet': https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/bechtle-aktie-gewinnprognose-steigt-nach-starkem-quartal-mwb-hebt-kursziel-an

findings.finding: The raised EBT guide is arithmetically conservative: 9M 2026 EBT is about EUR233.8m (H1 EUR141.8m + Q3 about EUR92m), +15.4% on 9M 2025's EUR202.6m, while FY2025 EBT was about EUR327m (3.8% of about EUR8.6bn BV). '>10%' therefore needs Q4 EBT of only about EUR126m, about +1% on Q4 2025, and the company says Q4 momentum continues.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises in 2026 moved the ad-hoc day (+14.8% on 28 Jul, +1.95% on 5 Nov), not the later report day (-3.78% on 12 Aug).
findings.original_quote: Beim EBT erwartet Bechtle nun ein Wachstum von mehr als 10 %. ... Diese positive Geschäftsentwicklung setzt sich auch im bisherigen Verlauf des vierten Quartals fort. [Bechtle now expects EBT growth of more than 10%. ... This positive business trend has continued so far in the fourth quarter.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: ten analysts can do this arithmetic, and the stock sold the raise from +8% intraday down to +1.95%. The only unpriced part is whether the call quantifies a higher number.

findings.finding: Peer Cancom cut its 2026 revenue guide by ad-hoc on 26 Oct (to EUR1.65-1.75bn from EUR1.75-1.85bn; Q3 revenue about EUR412m against EUR423.9m) on customer purchase restraint, and Bechtle fell with it in the MDAX on 27 Oct.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 27 Oct 2026: Bechtle down alongside Cancom; Jefferies expected Bechtle's Q3 to be better than Cancom's, and it was (+19% BV).
findings.original_quote: IT-Dienstleister Cancom kappt Umsatzprognose für 2026 - Aktie im Minus [IT service provider Cancom cuts its 2026 revenue forecast; shares down]
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, and contradicted for Bechtle's own Q3 by Bechtle's ad-hoc. All that remains is sector read-across into Q4 commentary on the call.

findings.finding: Two small bolt-on acquisitions since Q2: Technology First / ITQuotes in Ireland (>EUR30m revenue, 23 Oct) and Bespoke XYZ / Savvy in the UK (GBP3.5m revenue, 5 Nov). Both are immaterial to the group's roughly EUR9bn+ business volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: bolt-ons are routine for Bechtle (3-5 a year per its 2030 strategy).
findings.original_quote: Den Bespoke-Jahresumsatz gibt Bechtle mit 3,5 Mill. Pfund an. [Bechtle puts Bespoke's annual revenue at GBP3.5m.]
findings.why_not_priced: Public and immaterial; filed only because it is a sourced fact.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly positive (+0.38, from a small 0.54% short and a flat run-up) and the findings lean mildly negative on cash flow and the name's habit of fading. They cut against the lean, but neither side is strong.
language_note: The German ad-hoc text is identical to the English one; the original was quoted for the guide wording.
The German press (Boersen-Zeitung, stock3, goldesel) carried the intraday shape of 5 Nov (+8% fading to +2.4%) and the size of the Bespoke deal (GBP3.5m), which the English results did not.
German sources (deutsche-boerse dpa-AFX roundup, boerse-express) carried the Cancom peer guide cut and Bechtle's sympathy move on 27 Oct; the English searches did not surface them.
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): cash-flow finding enlarged from -1.0 to -1.5; p_up 46 to 45.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': guide-arithmetic finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because the guide is pre-released and the arithmetic is public.
'Company document beats an industry proxy': Cancom read-across cut from -0.2 to -0.1, because Bechtle's own ad-hoc contradicts it for Q3.

'Understatement / size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 3.8, since cash flow and revenue are new lines on a name with 30%+ realised vol, still close to the about 3% pre-released base.
